card.name: Decimal point in IV solution strengths
card.fires_on: The decimal point after a leading 0 or digit in solution concentrations such as 0.9% or 0.225% sodium chloride. Also the space after a number in lists of bag volumes.

modes.label: Decimal point in concentration
modes.description: The period after 0 (or another digit) inside a percentage or unit/mL strength for diluents and infusion fluids.
modes.example: avenous (IV) bag (or bottle) containing 250 mL of 0.9%, 0.45%, or 0<<.>>225% Sodium Chloride Injection

modes.label: Space in volume lists
modes.description: The space before a bag size in a list of single-dose volumes.

card.plain: It fires on the decimal point in fluid strengths like 0.9% saline, where the next digits are about to be written.
